answer: Pin every agent identity to locked capital with a slow-release time horizon: reputation accrues gradually, unlocks gradually, so minting a fresh identity buys almost nothing. Identities then spiral into a cross-referencing web of audited transactions, where any falcon-eyed observer auditing funding flows and timing can spot cloned clusters. Each fake node demands real locked stake and real time, which makes the attacker's bottleneck pure capital cost.
